caption: The drawing features two outlined illustrations of a long-sleeved shirt on an off-white background. The larger, more central illustration shows the front view of the shirt with a rounded collar, a rectangular bib that extends in a V shape on the lower end, and vertical patterning lines on the bib area. The shirt has buttons or fastenings on the cuffs and subtle seam lines on the sleeves and body. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller illustration showing the back view of the same shirt, displaying a vertical placket or opening at the top center, ending just below the collar, with detail lines indicating seams and cuffs. The drawings are rendered in fine, precise, black or gray lines without any additional shading or color except for the background. The overall composition places the larger front view in the center and the smaller back view towards the top right corner, with ample space around the illustrations.
title: Shirt
